lines.en: My claws crunch through fallen leaves.
I weave between the trees.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过低矮的蕨
lines.en: My tail sweeps the low ferns.

lines.zh: 我一步一步搜索这片地
lines.en: I search the ground, step by step.
My snout stays close to the ground.

lines.zh: 我沿着泥地里的脚印走
lines.en: I follow the prints in the mud.
Light bones, and I am not slow.
I lift my head and sniff ahead.
I step around a fallen trunk.
My strange call echoes through the wood.
I duck low through the brush.
I head toward the sound of water.
Each step lands softly.

lines.zh: 我在林线边上停了下来
lines.en: I stop at the edge of the treeline.

lines.zh: 我站着，听林子里的动静
lines.en: I stand and listen to the wood.
Something small is running out there.
My head tilts a little.
I open my jaws to let the heat out.

lines.zh: 这叫声连我自己都觉得怪
lines.en: Even I find my call strange.
I stare at one bush for a long time.
The wind passes over my spine.
My claw draws circles in the mud.

lines.zh: 我伏低，把肚子贴在地上
lines.en: I lower my belly to the earth.
The wood is suspiciously quiet.
I grind my teeth audibly.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等一个影子
lines.en: I hold still, waiting for a shadow.
My breath stirs the grass.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖在轻轻抽动
lines.en: The tip of my tail twitches.
I see you standing stiff as a dead post.
I am estimating how much you weigh.
My head rides a little above yours.
I have noted your scent.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看你手里的东西
lines.en: I tilt my head at what you hold.
You keep still, so do I.
I was in this wood first.

lines.zh: 我的牙露在外面，不是笑
lines.en: My teeth show, and it is not a smile.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身后还有气味。
lines.en: I smell someone else behind you.
I retreat half a step, then stop.
You have looked at me too long.
Come closer and I will stop being polite.
My ribs ache from the blow.
I growl and give half a step.
I need a moment after that.
My legs feel weak.
The smell of my own blood rises.
I shake the hurt leg.
I saw who hit me.
My call comes out hoarse.
My legs can still carry me.
Pain makes me more careful.
I know that smell of meat.
Holding it high will not help.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子比你的眼睛灵
lines.en: My nose is quicker than your eyes.
Throw it, do not hand it over.
I bite and run without looking back.
That will not fill one bite.
Step back and I will come for it.
I am starting to drool.
The meat covers your scent.
It's the meat in your palm I'm watching.
You hit my ribs.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，你却跟上来
lines.en: I turn aside, and you follow.
Do not put your face near my jaws.
You stepped on my claw.
We both step back a pace.
My tail whips your leg.
You nearly tripped me.
I turn my shoulder to shed the impact.
A low growl escapes me.
Out of my way.
We push through the ferns side by side.
Her call is higher than mine.
We sniff each other's necks.
This hunting ground can feed us both.
I lead, and she follows.

lines.zh: 我们在树下停了一会儿
lines.en: We pause beneath a tree.
Our shadows overlap.

lines.zh: 我替她看着后面的林子
lines.en: I watch the trees behind her.

lines.zh: 我们叫了一声，算是答应
lines.en: One call each, and that is agreement.
Quiet now, it is only us.
I saw this meat first.
I take it and back behind a tree.
I pin the meat under my foreclaw.
I do not ask who dropped it.
Too tough for my teeth.
I carry it and chew as I walk.
This one is worth hiding.
I cover the meat with fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我闻出上面有别人的味
lines.en: I smell someone else on it.
Let go, this is mine.
You walked into my hunting ground.
You are already my prey.
My call changes pitch.
You are far easier than a deer.
I lower myself to run.

lines.zh: 你的背后是灌木，跑不快
lines.en: Bushes behind you, you cannot run fast.
I no longer have to wait.
I found you first.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让你看清我的牙
lines.en: I turn to show you my teeth.
I can see you wear no armour.

lines.zh: 这个距离刚好够我起跳
lines.en: This is just the distance for a leap.
One step, then another.

lines.zh: 这就是我一直在等的味道
lines.en: This is the scent I was waiting for.
I stop calling and start moving.
I circle to your flank.
You turn, and I turn with you.
I hold each step with my tail.
I wait for your neck to show.

lines.zh: 你看不见的蕨丛我都知道
lines.en: I know every fern you cannot see through.

lines.zh: 我一边跟一边数你的步子
lines.en: I follow and count your paces.
Your breathing has quickened.
I move along the tree shadows.
Only a few blades of grass between us.
I open my jaws, then close them.
I let you think I left.

lines.zh: 这片林子会替我把声音藏住
lines.en: This wood will hide my sound.
I crouch and gather myself.
Metriacanthosaurus teeth go for the wrist.

lines.zh: 再走三步就进我的范围
lines.en: Three more steps and you are in range.
I drop low and lunge.
My teeth clamp your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一口是撕的，不是咬的
lines.en: This is a tear, not a bite.
The taste of blood speeds me up.
The impact drops you to the ground.
My foreclaw pins you down.
Do not pull, my teeth are hooked.
I shake my head once.
Your bone makes a sound.
That bite will send you far back.
I bite again.

lines.zh: 你挡得住我的手，挡不住我的牙
lines.en: You can block my claws, not my teeth.
I pull back with blood in my mouth.
Only panting remains in the wood.
I step out of the tree shadows.
The wood has one more pair of eyes.
I smell a new hunting ground.
My call scatters the birds first.

lines.zh: 我从欧洲的岩层里被唤醒
lines.en: Woken from the rock layers of Europe.
I snap the first dry branch.
There are too few deer here.
I lift my head to read the wood.
My shadow falls on the ferns.

lines.zh: 你最好别在这时候路过
lines.en: You had best not pass by now.

lines.zh: 我弓着背踏进这片蕨丛。
lines.en: I stalk into these ferns, back arched.
My tail sweeps the brush first.
The wind here carries meat.
I pull my foot out of the mud.

lines.zh: 我第一次在这片地留下脚印
lines.en: My first prints on this ground.
The birds have gone quiet.
I am here, and the wood is mine.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，试了试这儿的空气
lines.en: I open my jaws and taste the air.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的鳞，焦味刺鼻
lines.en: Fire scorches my scales, sharp and bitter.
I tumble down the slope.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的肺，我拼命挣扎
lines.en: Water floods my lungs and I thrash.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻在蕨丛里
lines.en: The blast flips me into the ferns.
An arrow sticks in my side.
Magic burns along my bones.
Hunger whites out my sight.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我背上，我趴下了
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I drop.

lines.zh: 我踩空了，脚下什么都没有
lines.en: I step into nothing at all.
